quote: Therefore, the IAPs play a greater role in gut homeostasis, immunity and IBD development than previously suspected, and may have therapeutic potential.
summary: Review of IAP family members (cIAP1, cIAP2, XIAP) in intestinal immunity and IBD, noting therapeutic potential, with no new data on cIAP2 specifically.
The alias MIHC here means multiplex immunohistochemistry in a colorectal cancer liver metastasis study, not BIRC3.

quote: We discovered that Mettl21c knockdown modulated only the NF-κB signaling pathway (ie, Birc3, Ccl5, and Tnf).
summary: Birc3 is one of three NF-kB pathway genes changed after Mettl21c knockdown in muscle and bone cell lines; no UC or colitis data.

quote: Finally, we show that A. muciniphila induces the expression of the MUC2, BIRC3 and TNFAIP3 genes involved in the maintenance of the intestinal barrier function and that this process is dependent on TIFA.
summary: Akkermansia muciniphila induces BIRC3 expression in intestinal epithelial cells through a TIFA-dependent pathway.

quote: Recent research has shown that cellular IAP1 (cIAP1), cIAP2, and X-linked IAP (XIAP) also regulate signaling by receptors of the innate immune system by ubiquitylating their substrates.
summary: General review of IAP protein functions in cell death and inflammation and of IAP antagonist drugs, with no UC-specific data.

quote: In complementary studies of humans with IBD we found that expression of RICK, cellular inhibitor of apoptosis protein 2 (cIAP2) and downstream signaling partners were markedly increased in inflamed tissue of IBD compared to controls without marked elevations of NOD1 or NOD2 expression.
summary: cIAP2 expression was markedly increased in inflamed IBD tissue compared with controls, alongside RICK.

quote: Injection of TNF greatly increased levels of cell death in intestinal tissue of cIAP1-null mice, compared with wild-type C57BL/6 mice, cIAP2-null mice, or XIAP-null mice.
summary: cIAP2-null mice showed no excess TNF-induced intestinal cell death, unlike cIAP1-null mice, so cIAP2 loss had no clear effect.

quote: Here, we review the current understanding of IAP-mediated PRR signaling and how IAP proteins might present as promising targets for anti-inflammatory therapies in PRR-dependent inflammatory diseases including Crohn's disease, Blau syndrome, and septic shock.
summary: Review of IAP proteins including cIAP2 in innate immune signalling and as possible anti-inflammatory targets.

quote: Protein-protein interaction analysis showed 10 hub genes (BIRC3, ICAM1, IRAK2, MAP3K8, S100A8, SOCS3, STAT5A, TNF, TNFAIP3, TNIP1).
summary: BIRC3 is one of ten hub genes in a COVID-19 lung epithelial transcriptomics analysis; nothing about UC.

quote: Antiapoptotic pathways including nuclear factor kappa B activation and one of its transcriptional targets, cIAP2 (c inhibitor of apoptosis protein 2) gene expression, and ERK/MAP kinase activation are all inhibited in TNF-treated kinase-inactive KSR-expressing young adult mouse colon cells.
summary: cIAP2 expression is a downstream readout reduced when KSR signaling is blocked in TNF-treated mouse colon cells; cIAP2 itself was not perturbed.

quote: Nine genes (ACSL1, BIRC3, CLC, CREM, ELTD1, FGG, S100A9, THBD, and TPD52L1) were progressively and significantly upregulated from controls to nondysplastic UC to UC with neoplasia.
summary: BIRC3 is one of nine genes progressively upregulated from control to UC to UC with neoplasia, with no BIRC3-specific follow-up.

quote: In vitro, luteolin sensitized colonic epithelial HT29 cells to TNFalpha-induced apoptosis, caspase 3 activation, DNA fragmentation and reduced TNFalpha-induced C-IAP1, C-IAP2 and COX-2 gene expression.
summary: Luteolin lowered TNF-induced cIAP2 expression in HT29 cells; cIAP2 itself was not perturbed.
The alias MIHC here means multiplex immunohistochemistry in a pancreatic cancer trial, not BIRC3.

quote: We have identified multiple regulatory steps regulated by zinc availability which include the induction of cellular Inhibitor of APoptosis (cIAP2) mRNA, possibly through activation of Nuclear Factor-Kappa B (NF-κB), as both nuclear translocation of the p65 subunit of NF-κB and up-regulation of cIAP2 mRNA were impaired following zinc depletion.
summary: TNF-induced cIAP2 mRNA in Caco-2 cells depends on intracellular zinc and is impaired by zinc depletion.

quote: TNFα induces BIRC3/cIAP2 transcripts and reduces NKp46/NCR1 transcription and surface expression on NK cells, promoting metastases dissemination in mice and poor prognosis in GIST patients.
summary: In a cancer study, TNF induces BIRC3 transcripts in NK cells; there is no UC or colitis data.

quote: Exposure of Caco-2 cells to UCC118 led to the induction of several human genes (TNFAIP3, NFKBIA, and BIRC3) that are negative regulators of inflammatory signaling pathways.
summary: Probiotic L. salivarius UCC118 induced BIRC3 expression in Caco-2 intestinal epithelial cells.

quote: Dietary FS exacerbated DSS-induced acute colitis, as indicated by a heightened disease activity index and an increase in colonic injury and inflammatory biomarkers [histological damage, apoptosis, myeloperoxidase, inflammatory cytokines (IL-6 and IL-1β), and NF-κB signaling-related genes (Nfkb1, Ccl5, Bcl2a1a, Egfr, Relb, Birc3, and Atf1)].
summary: Birc3 is one of several NF-kB-related genes raised in DSS colitis mice fed flaxseed; no gene-specific result.
The alias MIHC here means multiplex immunohistochemistry in a cervical cancer study, not BIRC3.

quote: Here we show that the IAP proteins cIAP2 and XIAP are required for efficient fusion of lysosomes with autophagosomes.
summary: Loss or inhibition of cIAP2 and XIAP blocks autophagic flux in cells, possibly relevant to Crohn's disease; no inflammation outcome was measured.

quote: In SW480 colon cancer cells, NF-κB activation by CPT was accompanied by secretion of the cytokine CXCL8, but not by up-regulation of the anti-apoptotic genes, cIAP2 or Bcl-XL.
summary: In colon cancer cells, camptothecin-induced NF-kB activation did not raise cIAP2 expression; no UC data.
The alias MIHC here means multiplex immunohistochemistry in a tertiary lymphoid structure review, not BIRC3.
Periodontitis study that mentions only C3a and C5a receptor-deficient mice, not the C3 gene itself.

quote: Inadequate complement activation becomes a disease cause, as in atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome, C3 glomerulopathies, and systemic lupus erythematosus.
summary: General review of the complement system in immunity and disease; it has no UC-specific data on C3.
C3 here means the three-carbon short chain fatty acid propionate, not the complement gene.

quote: Subsequently, genetic studies revealed highly significant statistical associations between AMD and variants of several complement pathway-associated genes including: Complement factor H (CFH), complement factor H-related 1 and 3 (CFHR1 and CFHR3), complement factor B (CFB), complement component 2 (C2), and complement component 3 (C3).
summary: C3 variants are associated with age-related macular degeneration; this paper has no UC data.
